Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The questions and workflow were refined over roughly two years with multiple rounds of feedback.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.development-process

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Subsequent paragraphs describe example datasheets, product teams, researcher/practitioner/policy comments and legal feedback; this is author-reported development, not a controlled effectiveness trial.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 3; 2 Development Process, first paragraph

    roughly two years

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The paper states that datasheets alone are not a complete mitigation for unwanted societal bias or potential dataset harms.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.documentation-mitigation-limit

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Creators cannot anticipate every use, demographic information may be unavailable, and documentation imposes time and organizational overhead.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 11; 4 Impact and Challenges, paragraph beginning Datasheets for datasets

    do not provide a complete solution

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The authors intend datasheet creation to involve reflective human documentation rather than an automated creation process.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.nonautomated-reflection

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • This is a normative framework design objective, not evidence that all later datasheet tools or datasets follow it.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 3; 1.1 Objectives, final paragraph

    not intended to be automated

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: For infrequently changing datasets, the authors recommend accompanying updated dataset versions with updated datasheets.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.updated-version-docs

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Dynamic datasets are identified as an implementation challenge. Dataset families and successive releases should retain separate documentation scope.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 11; 4 Impact and Challenges, first full paragraph

    updated versions with updated datasheets

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Datasheets for Datasets (arXiv 1803.09010v8) · paper method: The proposed collection-process documentation asks dataset creators to identify collection participants and their compensation.

candidate.paperfull.datasheets.worker-compensation-disclosure

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • This is a recommended disclosure question. It does not establish participation, fair payment or a particular supplier contract for any dataset.
  • Datasheets for DatasetsLocator: PDF p. 7; 3.3 Collection Process, fourth bullet

    how much were crowdworkers paid
